A '''power prybar''' was a powered version of a [[Prybar/Legends|prybar]] used to assist in opening items. Made of metal, the power prybar consisted of several flat prybars that were connected with fulcrums and hydraulic pistons. A small pressure [[Computer/Legends|computer]] calculated the force an individual applied to the power prybar, then provided extra leverage to complete the task. The power prybar was powered by a long-lasting internal [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]]. The tool was capable of prying gaps to about ten [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]]. Useful for prying open crates, the power prybar could also be used as a makeshift [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]].<ref name="PSG" />
